note: Formal garden between Hall (N), Block B (S) and Block A (E). Garden frame: origin M=(131.07,-28.03) = midpoint of the gazebo centres, u along the campus grid (0.99881,-0.04885), v grid-north. Paths are 1.2 m (3 x 0.40 m diamond concrete tiles) with scalloped concrete edging and ~1.05 m clipped hedges both sides; 'path' elements are paving data (builder skips them; terrain = paving). The garden floor is ~1 m below the Block-B side (boulder retaining wall along the south); the smooth terrain model does not carry that step.

elements.name: Gazebo_1
elements.ceiling: flat, slatted timber (pano: column top and post tops both 0.60-0.67 h above camera)
elements.notes: across_flats = post-centre octagon (builder convention). Eave (fascia bottom) = 2.77 m; apex ~5.0 m at 25 deg. Pier/parapet: red brick-effect tile (2026; plain maroon paint in 2020), white render posts with dark-brown capital band ~0.12 m.
elements.evidence: Octagon (8 posts, 8 sides), pyramid shingle roof. ROOF: Google z20 roof outline across flats 9.15 m (vertex-N octagon R=4.95 fits the N/NW/NE/E roof edge, 0.1 m/px). POST RING: 2020 in-gazebo 360 pano (tour360 gazebo.jpg): 7 visible parapet-base corners fitted by a regular octagon (rms 0.2 h); inner corner radius 2.60 h; fitted centre = central column (0.1 h). Camera h=1.55 m from floor tiles 0.25 h = 0.39 m (0.40 m tiles) and the roof size -> post-centre AF 7.7. Check 2026 frame 081924271 t7 (entrance side face-on): post c-c 1486 px vs 0.94 m brick-tile stub 450 px in the same plane -> side 3.19 m = AF 7.70. Equirect Cycles render of this spec from the fitted pano camera pose reproduces all 7 post azimuths within 1-5 deg and both openings. HEIGHTS: parapet top 0.61 h = 0.94 m (stub = 6.6 brick-tile courses of ~0.135 m + cap); post top / flat ceiling 1.665 h = 2.58 m (pano) and 2.71 x stub (t7) -> 2.6 m; ceiling is FLAT (column top and post tops at the same 0.60-0.67 h above camera). Roof pitch 18 deg: t6 frame apex 205 px above the fascia bottom at 388 px/m side scale, camera ~7 m out (f~2600 px, 4K main cam) -> apex ~4.4 m. OPENINGS: 2 adjacent sides (SSE, SSW), each ~1.15 m clear between ~0.8 m parapet stubs (pano pz_180, 081924271 t7-t10); other 6 sides parapet + continuous timber bench. Floor flush with the paths (same 0.40 m diamond tiles, no step). Materials: brown asphalt shingles, white fascia 0.2 m with dark triangular shingle tabs, dark-brown slatted ceiling, white rendered posts ~0.40 m sq with a dark-brown capital band, parapet/piers clad in red brick-effect tile (2026; painted maroon in 2020), dark-brown round central column d=0.20 m floor-to-ceiling. Centre: Google z20 roof (116.95,-26.75) minus north lean 0.18 m/m (Google B roof edge 1.3-1.7 m N of the Bing footprint) averaged with Bing 2021 (116.6,-26.6), then both gazebos snapped symmetric on the -2.8 deg campus grid (moves each <=0.35 m). Orientation from the 2020 pano: C block (4 fl.) at pano yaw 54-59 = bearing 58-63 from here -> pano yaw offset +4 deg -> a post (vertex) points grid-N, openings face bearings 160/205; confirmed by the SSE path on Google z20 (bearing 161.6, radial) and the N path at x=117.4 hitting the N vertex.
